import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
job_description = data.get("job_description")
master_cv = data.get("master_cv")
count = data.get("project_selection_count", data.get("selection_count", 4))
template = data.get("project_selection_prompt_template")

if not isinstance(job_description, str) or not job_description.strip():
    raise ValueError("job_description must be a non-empty string.")
if not isinstance(master_cv, dict):
    raise ValueError("master_cv must be an object.")
if not isinstance(template, str):
    raise ValueError("Project selection prompt is missing.")

projects = master_cv.get("projects")
if not isinstance(projects, list):
    raise ValueError("master_cv.projects must be an array.")

summaries = []
for index, project in enumerate(projects):
    description = project.get("description")
    if not isinstance(description, str) or not description.strip():
        content = project.get("content", [])
        description = " ".join(
            bullet for bullet in content[:2] if isinstance(bullet, str)
        )

    summaries.append({
        "index": index,
        "title": project.get("title", ""),
        "secondary": project.get("secondary", ""),
        "description": description,
    })

prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[selection_count]]", str(count))
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", job_description)
prompt = prompt.replace(
    "[[project_summaries_json]]",
    json.dumps(summaries, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")),
)

return [{"json": {**data, "project_selection_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
template = data.get("project_rewrite_prompt_template")
selected = data.get("selected_projects")

if not isinstance(template, str):
    raise ValueError("Project rewrite prompt is missing.")
if not isinstance(selected, list):
    raise ValueError("selected_projects must be an array.")

inputs = []
for project in selected:
    content = project.get("content")
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        raise ValueError("Each selected project needs a content array.")
    inputs.append({
        "title": project.get("title", ""),
        "content": content,
    })

compact = json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", data["job_description"])
prompt = prompt.replace("[[selected_projects_json]]", compact)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[rewrite_inputs_json]]", compact)

return [{"json": {**data, "project_rewrite_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
template = data.get("work_experience_selection_prompt_template")
count = data.get("work_experience_selection_count", 3)
experiences = data["master_cv"].get("work_experience", [])

if not isinstance(template, str):
    raise ValueError("Work-experience selection prompt is missing.")
if not isinstance(experiences, list):
    raise ValueError("master_cv.work_experience must be an array.")

summaries = []
for index, experience in enumerate(experiences):
    description = experience.get("description")
    if not isinstance(description, str) or not description.strip():
        content = experience.get("content", [])
        description = " ".join(
            bullet for bullet in content[:2] if isinstance(bullet, str)
        )

    summaries.append({
        "index": index,
        "title": experience.get("title", ""),
        "organization": experience.get("organization", ""),
        "secondary": experience.get("secondary", ""),
        "description": description,
    })

compact = json.dumps(summaries, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[selection_count]]", str(count))
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", data["job_description"])
prompt = prompt.replace("[[work_experience_summaries_json]]", compact)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[experience_summaries_json]]", compact)

return [{"json": {**data, "work_experience_selection_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
template = data.get("work_experience_rewrite_prompt_template")
selected = data.get("selected_work_experiences")

if not isinstance(template, str):

if not isinstance(selected, list):

inputs = []

    if not isinstance(content, list):

    inputs.append({
        "title": experience.get("title", ""),
        "organization": experience.get("organization", ""),
        "content": content,
    })

compact = json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", data["job_description"])
prompt = prompt.replace("[[selected_work_experiences_json]]", compact)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[rewrite_inputs_json]]", compact)

return [{"json": {**data, "work_experience_rewrite_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
template = data.get("summary_rewrite_prompt_template")

if not isinstance(template, str):
    raise ValueError("Summary prompt is missing.")

master_cv = data["master_cv"]
original_summary = master_cv.get("summary", [])
selected_indices = data.get("selected_work_experience_indices", [])
source_experiences = master_cv.get("work_experience", [])

experience_context = []
for index in selected_indices:
    experience = source_experiences[index]
    description = experience.get("description")
    if not isinstance(description, str) or not description.strip():
        content = experience.get("content", [])
        description = " ".join(
            bullet for bullet in content[:2] if isinstance(bullet, str)
        )

    experience_context.append({
        "title": experience.get("title", ""),
        "organization": experience.get("organization", ""),
        "description": description,
    })

context = {
    "original_summary": original_summary,
    "tailored_skills": data.get("tailored_skills", []),
    "experience_context": experience_context,
}

compact = json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", data["job_description"])
prompt = prompt.replace("[[summary_context_json]]", compact)
prompt = prompt.replace(
    "[[original_summary_json]]",
    json.dumps(original_summary, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")),
)
prompt = prompt.replace(
    "[[tailored_skills_json]]",
    json.dumps(data.get("tailored_skills", []), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")),
)
prompt = prompt.replace(
    "[[experience_context_json]]",
    json.dumps(experience_context, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")),
)

return [{"json": {**data, "summary_rewrite_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
summary = json.loads(data["summary_rewrite_response"]).get("summary")

if not isinstance(summary, list) or any(
    not isinstance(line, str) for line in summary
):
    raise ValueError("Summary output must contain a summary array of strings.")

master_cv = data["master_cv"]

final_cv = {
    **master_cv,
    "summary": summary,
    "skills": data["tailored_skills"],
    "projects": data["tailored_projects"],
    "work_experience": data["tailored_work_experience"],
}

prompt_usage = {}
for key in (
    "project_selection",
    "project_rewrite",
    "work_experience_selection",
    "work_experience_rewrite",
    "skills_tailoring",
    "summary_rewrite",
):
    prompt_usage[key] = {
        "prompt_key": data.get(f"{key}_prompt_key"),
        "version": data.get(f"{key}_prompt_version"),
        "temperature": data.get(f"{key}_temperature"),
    }

return [{
    "json": {
        "cv_json": final_cv,
        "prompt_usage": prompt_usage,
        "selected_project_indices": data.get("selected_project_indices", []),
        "selected_work_experience_indices": data.get(
            "selected_work_experience_indices",
            [],
        ),
        "job_id": data.get("job_id"),
        "company_name": data.get("company_name"),
        "job_title": data.get("job_title"),
        "job_description": data.get("job_description"),
        "job_url": data.get("job_url"),
        "application_id": data.get("application_id"),
        "published_at": data.get("published_at"),
        "location": data.get("location"),
        "contract_type": data.get("contract_type"),
        "source_job": data.get("source_job"),
    }
}]
